summary: Iteration 1: Full backend + frontend test of Decision Trust SaaS layer (Clerk auth, per-user workspaces, credits ledger, paid vs free actions, billing UI, Razorpay disabled). 17/17 pytest pass; race checks pass; all UI flows verified via Clerk ticket sign-in. No functional bugs found; only minor UX/code-quality notes.

minor.issue: Workspace store is mutated (and mode=replace clears data) BEFORE spend_credit; if spend fails under a concurrent race (credit already consumed), the ingest is applied but 402 returned without charge. Low impact; spend first (or reserve) then apply.
Per-user in-memory engines dict grows unbounded (one full TrustEngine per user ever seen) and resets on restart; no eviction (LRU/TTL). Memory risk as users grow.

integration_issues.issue: Reloading /ask?q=... (or browser back/forward to it) re-runs Ask on mount and spends another credit. Consider clearing q from the URL after the run (setSearchParams/replace) so refresh doesn't charge.
Migration plan variant 'Reconcile' link goes to /reconcile?a=..&b=.. which auto-runs and charges 1 credit without any '1 credit' label/tooltip on the link (Reconcile buttons elsewhere are labelled).

issues: Sidebar nav links and conflict-row buttons (Migration plan/Resolve/Dismiss) lack data-testid attributes
Disabled Buy buttons are light-blue on white - acceptable but low contrast text

action_items: (Minor) Clear ?q from /ask URL after the auto-run to avoid re-charging on refresh
(Minor) Label migration-plan 'Reconcile' links as using 1 credit
(Minor) In ingest, spend credit before mutating the store
(Optional) Add LRU eviction for per-user engines
critical_code_review_comments: ensure_member: grant-ledger insert uses find_one-then-insert (non-atomic); concurrent first requests tested with 8 parallel calls -> only 1 grant row, OK in practice but a unique index on (user_id,type=grant) would make it robust
spend_credit is atomic ($gte:1 conditional $inc) - verified: 6 concurrent asks at 1 credit -> 1x200, 5x402, credits 0
billing.py uses sync pymongo inside sync routes (threadpool) - acceptable
extract(): stray docstring after the commit check is dead code; harmless
seed_data_creation: Created Clerk+Mongo test users qa_a_t1, qa_b_t1, qa_c_t1, qa_race_t1, qa_ui_t1 (+clerk_test@example.com); all deleted afterwards by user_id (Mongo users/credit_ledger + Clerk user). Existing tester/tester2 accounts untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: for u in qa_a qa_b qa_c; do /root/.venv/bin/python /app/scripts/clerk_token.py ${u}_t1+clerk_test@example.com > /tmp/$u.json; done; then cd /app/backend && pytest tests_saas -n 0 (tests read tokens from /tmp/qa_*.json and need FRESH users for the 3-credit assertion). Cleanup: python tests_saas/cleanup_users.py /tmp/qa_*.json. UI: one-time ticket per browser session via /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=. Verified: signed-out redirect to /sign-in with branded panel; top bar 'Basic plan · free', credits, Buy credits; index 56; free pages don't spend; /ask and /reconcile without params don't auto-run; Home Ask -> exactly 1 credit (StrictMode guard works); reconcile preset -> 1 credit; at 0 credits Buy dialog opens with error note, Buy buttons disabled + amber notice; billing ledger shows +3 grant and -1 rows; orders 503; per-user isolation of deprecate/audit/ledger.
